as_told.title: 'Dog whistle' brings UAP in day after day

plain: A private group says it has a "dog whistle", a signal it switches on that draws UAPs, the official name for UFOs, to them day after day. Jake Barber, who works with the group, says it first-hand: "After we turn on the dog whistle, UAPs literally come to us day after day." James Valor, who also says he saw it, tells it in almost the same words in an interview about Skywatcher, a startup that tries to summon UFOs. Valor credits someone he calls Mr. K and places the work between 2021 and 2025. If true, it would mean these objects can be called in on demand and studied.
